methodology.physicalLines: Physical UTF-8 lines using the repository-growth counter; CRLF, LF and lone CR are separators and a final unterminated line counts once.
methodology.runtimeFiles: tracked source files under apps/web/src, apps/mobile and scripts, excluding tests and generated files
methodology.testFiles: tracked files identified by tests/__tests__ paths or .test/.spec filename markers
methodology.directAssociation: same-stem test beside the runtime file or a test import resolving directly to the runtime file; absence is not a coverage claim
methodology.coverageTruth: coverage-summary.json grouped by the discovered domain; AVAILABLE requires the canonical evidence for the matching Web or Mobile scope, the audited sourceSha, a clean checkout and a PASS execution status; other summaries remain PRESENT_NOT_ATTESTED observations
methodology.testDuplication: raw jscpd test-scope clone pairs measured from the checkout; the report records working-tree provenance and does not attribute the observation to sourceSha unless the checkout is clean at that SHA
methodology.provenance: structural metrics are read from the exact Git tree at sourceSha; coverage and jscpd are checkout observations and are attested only when their candidate evidence matches sourceSha

discovery.domainAssignment: current repository path organization with semantic path rules for web and top-level module rules for mobile/scripts

e2e.note: E2E is not part of SOURCE_ROOTS; repository-growth owns its physical inventory.

documentation.note: Documentation is intentionally outside source/module metrics; repository-growth owns the monorepo inventory.

vendored.note: Vendored/generated files are excluded from source discovery and counted once by repository-growth.

sharedInfrastructure.note: Shared infrastructure is outside module source roots and counted once by repository-growth.

monorepo.note: Module totals include source roots only; the repository-growth total remains the authoritative all-tree total.
